1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d4 Nc6 5.g3.strategy: Recaptures with the knight, which regains the central square d4 and keeps the pawn trade even. The centre is open now, and the knight on d4 and the knight on c6 face each other on a square both want.

Attacks the knight on d4 a second time, so that it is attacked twice and defended once, and eyes the b2 pawn as well. White has to react at once; Black gains time by harassing the knight, at the cost of bringing the queen out early.
1.Nf3 c5 2.c4 e6 3.Nc3 Nf6 4.d4 Nc6 5.g3.name: English Opening: Symmetrical Variation, Anti-Benoni Variation, Geller Variation
